reference_events.description: Helicase uses ATP hydrolysis to open the DNA helix, forming a local replication fork with separated leading and lagging templates.
reference_events.quote: A helicase using the energy from ATP hydrolysis opens up the DNA helix. Replication forks are formed at each replication origin as the DNA unwinds.

reference_events.description: Primase synthesizes RNA primers; DNA polymerase can then begin synthesis. Pol α adds a short DNA fragment to the primer on both strands before handoff.
reference_events.quote: Primers are formed by the enzyme primase, and using the primer, DNA pol can start synthesis. Three major DNA polymerases are then involved: α, δ and ε. DNA pol α adds a short (20 to 30 nucleotides) DNA fragment to the RNA primer on both strands, and then hands off to a second polymerase.

reference_events.description: Pol ε continuously synthesizes the leading strand.
reference_events.quote: While the leading strand is continuously synthesized by the enzyme pol ε , the lagging strand is synthesized by pol δ .

reference_events.description: Pol δ synthesizes the lagging strand in short stretches (Okazaki fragments), each initiated by a separate primer.
reference_events.quote: the lagging strand is synthesized by pol δ .

reference_events.description: On the lagging strand, DNA synthesis occurs in short stretches each initiated by a separate primer.
reference_events.quote: On the lagging strand, DNA is synthesized in short stretches, each of which is initiated by a separate primer.

reference_events.description: As Pol δ encounters the RNA primer on the lagging strand, it displaces the primer from the DNA template.
reference_events.quote: As pol δ runs into the primer RNA on the lagging strand, it displaces it from the DNA template.

reference_events.description: The displaced RNA primer is removed by RNase H (also called flap endonuclease) and replaced with DNA nucleotides.
reference_events.quote: The displaced primer RNA is then removed by RNase H (AKA flap endonuclease ) and replaced with DNA nucleotides.

reference_events.description: Okazaki fragments are joined after RNA primers are replaced with DNA.
reference_events.quote: The Okazaki fragments in the lagging strand are joined after the replacement of the RNA primers with DNA.

reference_events.description: DNA ligase seals remaining gaps by forming phosphodiester bonds.
reference_events.quote: The gaps that remain are sealed by DNA ligase, which forms the phosphodiester bond.
